title: Paint Brand Poll Results
content: Thanks to all 146 of you who joined the oil paint brand poll. Here are the results.The first number is the number of you who said you use that brand. After each brand is the list price/current sale price for a 37-40 ml tube of ultramarine blue from one of the online art suppliers.102 Winsor & Newton     13.90/6.9545 Gamblin     10.95/8.2137 Old Holland   13.29/10.6330 Grumbacher   9.25/6.1122 Holbein   11.95/7.9319 Williamsburg   12.95/9.345-10 Art Spectrum, Blockx, Cennini, Daler-Rowney, LeFranc&Bourgeois, Permalba, Schmicke, Sennelier, and Vasari.All other brands received fewer than 5 votes. In the comments, feel free to say what you love or hate about any of the kinds of oil paint.And if you have a second, please add your vote to the art medium poll at left.
